observed_defect: Flat, untextured prairie ground without rolling hills or valleys
design_intent: Create asymmetric, gentle rolling hills and valleys for strategic visibility from fixed camera, preserving city pad and outer border
expected_visual_difference: Visible terrain undulations from fixed camera perspective

actions.reason: Create asymmetric rolling hills by extruding from base mesh, preserving city pad and outer border, using low amplitude to avoid visual clutter
Define valley by inseting a shallow depression to create visual contrast with hills, ensuring contact with existing terrain
Refine hill silhouette with subdivision, then bevel edges to create soft, natural transitions for mobile performance and visual clarity
